title: Diffusion Models for Smarter UAVs: Decision-Making and Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2501.05819v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly used in modern communication networks. However, challenges in decision-making and digital modeling continue to hinder their rapid development. Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms face limitations such as low sample efficiency and limited data versatility, which are further amplified in UAV communications scenarios. Additionally, Digital Twin (DT) modeling presents significant challenges in decision-making and data management. RL models, often integrated into DT frameworks to address these issues, require large amounts of training data to make accurate predictions. Unlike traditional approaches that focus on class boundaries, Diffusion Models (DMs)-a new class of generative AI-learn the underlying probability distribution from training data and can generate reliable new patterns based on this learned distribution. translated_title: 面向更智能无人机的扩散模型：决策与建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.05819v2 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：无人机（UAV）在现代通信网络中的应用日益广泛。然而，决策制定和数字建模方面的挑战仍阻碍其快速发展。强化学习（RL）算法面临样本效率低和数据多样性有限等局限，这些问题在无人机通信场景中被进一步放大。此外，数字孪生（DT）建模在决策和数据管理方面存在显著挑战。常被集成到DT框架中以解决这些问题的RL模型，需要大量训练数据才能做出准确预测。与传统关注类别边界的方法不同，扩散模型（DMs）——一种新型生成式人工智能——从训练数据中学习潜在的概率分布，并能基于该学习到的分布生成可靠的新模式。DT和RL在实现智能、数据驱动的决策中具有互补作用。
tldr: 本文探讨了扩散模型如何通过生成式学习增强无人机在通信网络中的决策与建模能力，克服强化学习样本效率低和数字孪生数据管理难等挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper explores how diffusion models enhance UAV decision-making and modeling in communication networks by generative learning, overcoming challenges like low RL sample efficiency and difficult digital twin data management.
